items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: I used to follow up, uh, uh, Freddie Kepit all the time... I'd play that and so Louie would say... He'd call Freddie and say, come on Freddie and play.

ctx.x: Well, I was going to go way back again, a little bit slower on your life. Do you remember when you were just a little kid, the first music you heard? The first, yeah. The first, yeah. The first, bands or what were they?

Well, I used to follow up, uh, uh, Freddie Kepit all the time, you know. And, uh, Big Al Louie. Louie DeLia is writing there. Yeah. I agree. Very well. Yeah. And I used to go up on the stand and say, uh, Mr. Freddie, would you let me play a little piece? And he'd say, sure. And I couldn't play it but a full piece. I wish I could shimmy like my sister Kate, I forgot the others, you know. And I'd play that and so Louie would say, what are you going to play it now, son? I'd say, play it right over again, same thing…
Do you remember who else was in that terminal band? Any other famous musicians?
